summary: Defines a YANG data model for customers and operators to communicate about delivering Layer 3 VPN services, limited to BGP PE-based VPNs. It is a service-level model, not for direct device configuration. Replaced by RFC 8299.

eli5.summary: A form where a business tells its network company what private network it wants. The company's tools turn the order into real settings.

questions: what is the l3vpn service model

subtitle: A YANG data model that lets customers and operators describe a Layer 3 VPN order in one abstract, device-independent form.

tldr.problem: Operators and customers have no common, machine-readable way to say what a Layer 3 VPN service should look like, so each order is handled in a different way.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC defines a YANG module, ietf-l3vpn-svc, with two main containers, vpn-services and sites. A management system takes this service-level model as input and works out the detailed configuration of the network elements.
tldr.outcome: It gave a shared vocabulary for BGP PE-based VPN orders. It was later obsoleted by RFC 8299, which is the version to use now.

today: RFC 8049 is a Proposed Standard published in February 2017 and has been obsoleted by RFC 8299, which is the current version of this service model.

sections.title: What the Model Is For
sections.content:
RFC 8049 defines a Layer 3 VPN service data model written in YANG. A Layer 3 IP VPN service is a collection of sites that are authorized to exchange traffic with each other over a shared IP infrastructure. The model is limited to BGP PE-based VPNs as described in RFC 4026, RFC 4110 and RFC 4364.

The model defines service configuration elements that can be used in communication protocols between customers and network operators. They can also be input to automated control and configuration applications.

The RFC defines three roles of equipment. A CE (customer edge) device is dedicated to a customer and connects at Layer 3 to one or more PE devices. A PE (provider edge) device is managed by the service provider and can support multiple VPNs for different customers.
sections.eli5: A company with offices in many cities wants them to share a private network. This model is the standard form for asking the network company to build it.

sections.title: A Service Model, Not a Device Model
sections.content:
The model is an abstracted interface between customers and network operators. It is intended to be instantiated at the management system and is not a configuration model to be used directly on network elements. A typical scenario is an orchestration layer that takes the model as input and translates it into configuration of the network elements.

How the elements are configured is left to the operator. The RFC lists the CLI, NETCONF or RESTCONF coupled with YANG models for BGP, VRF or BFD, or some other technique. Section 8 expects the work to be split between a service component, which holds the service model, and a configuration component, which talks to the devices.

The RFC anticipates separate YANG models for the network elements, covering VRF definition, physical interface, the IP layer, QoS, routing protocols, multicast VPN and network address translation.
sections.eli5: The customer fills in the order form, not the factory settings. A helper program at the network company reads the form and sets every machine up properly.

sections.title: Structure: VPN Services and Sites
sections.content:
The YANG module is divided into two main containers: vpn-services and sites. Each vpn-service list entry holds the global parameters of one VPN for a specific customer, such as the service topology, cloud access, multicast and extranet settings.

A site is a customer office connected to one or more VPNs. It has an identifier, locations, optional devices, a management type (co-managed, customer-managed or provider-managed) and a list of site-network-access entries. Each network access is an IP logical connection of the site, and a multihomed site has several. Each access has a bearer, meaning the properties below Layer 3, and an ip-connection, meaning the Layer 3 protocol properties.

Some parameters, such as routing, services and security, can be set at both the site level and the access level. If both are set, the access-level value MUST override the site-level one. The model is modular through features, such as IPv4, IPv6, extranet VPNs, site diversity and QoS, and it can be extended by augmentation.
sections.eli5: There is a list of private networks, and a list of offices. Each office has one or more plugs into the network, and the form says what each plug needs.

sections.title: VPN Topologies, Cloud, Multicast and Extranets
sections.content:
The VPN service topology is one of three. In any-to-any, all sites can communicate without restriction, and this is the default. In Hub and Spoke, spokes talk only to hubs, and hubs can talk to each other. In Hub and Spoke disjoint, spokes talk only to hubs and hubs cannot talk to each other. Each site has a role in the topology, and in an any-to-any VPN all sites MUST have the same role, any-to-any-role.

The management system is expected to allocate route targets (RTs) and VRFs on the PEs. Any-to-any generally needs a single RT, while hub and spoke needs two.

Other service features include cloud access, with optional NAT44 and permit or deny lists of sites, multicast, with customer tree flavors and rendezvous point settings, and extranet VPNs. If VPN A lists VPN B as an extranet, all sites in VPN B gain access to all sites in VPN A, even though VPN B needs no configuration. Carriers' Carriers support uses LDP or BGP as the MPLS signalling protocol.
sections.eli5: You can build the private network as a free-for-all, or as a star where small offices only talk to the main office. You can also let one private network borrow things from another.

sections.title: Attaching Sites and Placing Them
sections.content:
A site's VPN multiplexing is set by site-vpn-flavor, which has four values: site-vpn-flavor-single (one VPN), site-vpn-flavor-multi (several VPNs, all accesses in the same set), site-vpn-flavor-sub (different accesses map to different VPNs) and site-vpn-flavor-nni (the site represents an option A NNI). A site is attached to a VPN through the mandatory vpn-attachment container, either by naming a VPN directly or by referencing a vpn-policy for more complex cases.

The management system decides where each access connects. It SHOULD honor customer constraints, and if a constraint is too strict to meet it MUST NOT provision the site. Accesses can be tagged with group identifiers, and constraints such as pe-diverse, pop-diverse, linecard-diverse, bearer-diverse, same-pe and same-bearer are written against those groups. When placement is impossible, the system SHOULD return an error.

For redundancy, the access-priority leaf expresses a preference, and the higher value is preferred. The RFC gives a five-access example with values 100, 100, 50, 50 and 10. Traffic protection and optional encryption at Layer 2 or Layer 3 are also modelled.
sections.eli5: The form lets you say which office plugs in where, for example that two plugs must not go into the same building so one survives if the other breaks.

sections.title: Routing, Bandwidth and QoS Parameters
sections.content:
The ip-connection sets IPv4 and IPv6 addressing. The address allocation types are provider-dhcp, provider-dhcp-relay, static-address, slaac and provider-dhcp-slaac. BFD is the supported fault-detection mechanism for OAM.

Routing protocols between the provider and the site are configured per site or access, including static routes, RIP, OSPF, BGP and VRRP. Service bandwidth is given as svc-input-bandwidth and svc-output-bandwidth in bits per second, from the customer site's point of view. These can differ, which lets the provider tell if the customer accepts asymmetric access.

QoS is abstracted into an ordered qos-classification-policy that matches a flow or application and sets a target class, and a qos-profile that is either a standard profile from the operator or a custom list of classes. Custom class properties include a rate limit as a percentage of the service bandwidth, latency and jitter.
sections.eli5: The form also asks how the office gets its address, how fast the connection should be, and which kinds of traffic go first, like letting video calls jump the queue.

sections.title: Network-to-Network Interfaces
sections.content:
VPNs sometimes need to span different autonomous systems or different providers. The RFC says NNIs have to be defined to extend VPNs across multiple ASes, and notes that RFC 4364 defines several NNI flavors with different pros and cons, which it leaves out of scope.

The model shows how option A, option B and option C style NNIs can be expressed. For option A, ASBR peers use a VRF and a BGP session per interface, so traffic between back-to-back VRFs is plain IP. An option A NNI can be modelled as a site using site-vpn-flavor-nni, which tells the other provider this is not a regular customer site. The RFC lists uses such as extending footprint through L3VPN partners, connecting data center services and reaching private clouds.
sections.eli5: Sometimes two network companies must join their networks so a customer's private network spans both. This part of the form describes how to ask for that join.

sections.title: Security and IANA Actions
sections.content:
The module MAY be accessed through RESTCONF or NETCONF, which require the transport to provide data integrity and confidentiality. The server MUST authenticate client access to protected resources, and the client identity is subject to the NETCONF Access Control Model. The entries under /l3vpn-svc/vpn-services/vpn-service and /l3vpn-svc/sites/site hold customer-proprietary or confidential information, so access MUST be limited to authorized clients.

The model itself offers limited security parameters. The authentication container is empty and is meant to be filled by augmentation. IANA assigned the XML namespace urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:yang:ietf-l3vpn-svc and registered the YANG module name ietf-l3vpn-svc with prefix l3vpn-svc.
sections.eli5: An order form has private information about a company, so only people allowed to see it should be able to open or change it.

items.title: Any-to-any
items.text: All sites communicate without restriction. This is the default.

items.title: Hub and Spoke
items.text: Spokes talk only to hubs, and hubs can talk to each other.

items.title: Hub and Spoke disjoint
items.text: Spokes talk only to hubs, and hubs cannot talk to each other.

items.label: site-vpn-flavor-single
items.desc: The site belongs to only one VPN.

items.label: site-vpn-flavor-multi
items.desc: Several VPNs, and all accesses belong to the same set of VPNs.

items.label: site-vpn-flavor-sub
items.desc: Several VPNs, with each logical access mapped to different VPNs.

items.label: site-vpn-flavor-nni
items.desc: The site represents an option A NNI.
